priority_items.title: AUS-PHL defence cooperation instrument signed; PNA + DFAT posted text
priority_items.summary: FACT: Teodoro and Ambassador Innes-Brown signed at Eva Macapagal Cruise Terminal, Manila South Harbor, 15 Nov, witnessed by Albanese. PNA (datePublished 05:47:42Z) names it a Defense Cooperation Agreement updating the 1995 MOU and complementing SOVFA. DFAT joint statement (Albanese, Marles, Wong, 15 Nov) names it a Defence Cooperation Arrangement covering maritime awareness, information-sharing, training, interoperability, and defence infrastructure. PHL CLAIM: SOVFA anti-red tape and WPS deterrence. PDF unpublished. ABC written still lags on 'set to be signed.' pm.gov.au/media still Antalya/COP31.
